name: FlipClip
desc: Clip text and regions from PDFs, e-books and notes, then aggregate and insert them into your notebooks. Position each clip with a drag-to-place box, mask parts with an erase tool before inserting, and undo the last placement. Adds an always-on-top floating button to switch between your two most-recent documents and open the clip tools; it checks the foreground app to auto-hide outside the Note and Document apps. All captures stay on your device — no network access. A fork of sn-clipper by Vinod Nair (MIT).
